## Workload

During the review period, Lena Fischer completed 737 reads over 367 hours. This represents a rate of 2.0 reads per hour. The workload record provides a clear account of activity completed during the period and supports review of both output and time spent. The figures were considered as part of the overall grader review.

## Quality

A sample of 69 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 59.4 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in interpretation and grading. The findings were reviewed by Priya Anand, who considered the workload and quality information together.
